verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṁ abhabbo niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, someone with five qualities is unable to step into the sure path with regards to skillful qualities even when listening to the true teaching.

verses.pali: Kathaṁ paribhoti, kathikaṁ paribhoti, attānaṁ paribhoti, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
verses.english: They disparage the talk, the speaker, or themselves. They’re witless, dull, and idiotic. They think they know what they don’t know.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṁ abhabbo niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṁ.
verses.english: Someone with these five qualities is unable to step into the sure path with regards to skillful qualities, even when listening to the true teaching.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṁ bhabbo niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṁ.
verses.english: Someone with five qualities is able to step into the sure path with regards to skillful qualities when listening to the true teaching.

verses.pali: Na kathaṁ paribhoti, na kathikaṁ paribhoti, na attānaṁ paribhoti, paññavā hoti ajaḷo aneḷamūgo, na anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
verses.english: They don’t disparage the talk, the speaker, or themselves. They’re wise, bright, and clever. They don’t think they know what they don’t know.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇanto saddhammaṁ bhabbo niyāmaṁ okkamituṁ kusalesu dhammesu sammattan”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these five qualities is able to step into the sure path with regards to skillful qualities when listening to the true teaching.”
